Make use of updrafts to soar high into the sky!|N/A|AoC}} also known as {{Term/Store|Gust Geyser|Gust Geysers|PH|plural}},{{Exp Game|PH}}{{Cite Guide|PH Prima|page= 15}} are a recurring mechanic in {{TLoZ Series}}. Updrafts go unnamed in {{MM}}, {{SS}} and {{TFH}}. ==Location and Uses== Updrafts are gusts of wind that push upward, often carrying whatever enters the column of wind with them. ==={{MM|-}}=== Updrafts can be found in the [[Stone Tower Temple]] in {{MM}}. They can be used by [[Deku Link]] to increase his altitude while gliding through the air. Deku Link can jump straight into a whirlwind to start flying without the use of a [[Deku Flower]]. ==={{TWW|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= TWW |type= Objects |category= Objects in The Wind Waker |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Where it can be found * Whether it can be interacted with and if it is important to the story or a Quest }} Updrafts appear in the [[Wind Temple]] and the [[Official Rito Tribe Bird-Man Contest]] in {{TWW}}. [[Link]] can use them to gain altitude while gliding with the [[Deku Leaf]]. Although Updrafts are mostly used as a boost while gliding, they can also be found as obstacles, such as in the Wind Temple, where various "updrafts" blowing downward will block Link's path until deactivated. Updrafts can also blow Link away unless he wears the [[Iron Boots]], which must be worn to walk through the wind currents. Other Updrafts can be found in the [[Great Sea]]. While sailing in the [[King of Red Lions]], these updrafts can catch Link and change his direction. ==={{TMC|-}}=== Updrafts are small vortexes found throughout [[Hyrule]] in {{TMC}}. [[Link]] can jump into them by using the [[Roc's Cape]] or by jumping off a ledge. When jumping into one, Link will hold onto [[Ezlo]] like a parachute, letting him glide through the air. Though they function as [[Tornado]]es, the [[Crimson Cyclone]]s in the [[Cloud Tops]] have the appearance of red Updrafts. ==={{PH|-}}=== Gust Geysers are found on Islands throughout the [[World of the Ocean King]], such as on the [[Isle of Gust]], either buried under soil or appearing naturally on the ground. When Link enters a Gust Geyser's column, he will be propelled upwards to a nearby ledge. If Gust Geysers are covered by soil, Link must uncover them with the [[Shovel]] in order to use them. Alternatively, Link may purposefully cover Gust Geysers with the Shovel to access areas otherwise blocked by their columns of wind. Some Updrafts are activated via [[Switch]]es. Link can throw [[Bomb]]s into Gust Geysers, to make them explode at higher elevations and blast obstacles which obstruct ledges. This tactic is necessary to defeat [[Cyclok]], the boss of the [[Temple of Wind]]. ==={{SS|-}}=== {{Stub}} Updrafts appear throughout [[The Surface]] in {{SS}}, such as in the [[Sealed Grounds]].{{Cite|I recommend using the air vents to move ahead of the monster instead of chasing it from behind.|Fi|SS}} By using the [[Sailcloth]] in tandem with these air vents, Link can ascend cliffs and ledges. Much like in {{PH|-}}, these vents of air may be trapped underground. Link can uncover these by using either the [[Digging Mitts]] or the [[Mogma Mitts]]. ==={{TFH|-}}=== Updrafts appear in Levels of the [[Sky Realm]] in {{TFH}}, where they are powered by large, upward facing [[Fan]]s or air vents. The [[Links]] will float in the air when they enter an Updraft, allowing them to reach higher ledges. In [[Dragon Citadel]], an enormous room with no floor must be traversed by [[Cucco]]-gliding between several scattered Updrafts. The [[Mini-Boss]] of the Sky Realm, [[Gigaleon]], can be rendered dizzy by creating Updrafts in its path, using the [[Gust Jar]] to fire a blast of air into one of the large Fans in the arena's corners. Later in the battle, these Updrafts can be used to launch one or more of the Links on top of the dizzied Gigaleon to attack its weak point directly. ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Descriptions BotW}} Updrafts can be caused by a variety of sources in {{BotW}}. Updrafts can occur when fire catches on grass or [[Spicy Pepper]]s, generating lift that [[Link]] can use in tandem with his [[Paraglider]] to soar into the sky. [[Dragon]]s also naturally generate Updrafts when they fly through the sky, allowing Link to match their vertical position. Updrafts created by Dragons also fully regenerate Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] whenever he draws his Paraglider while in them. Some Updrafts occur via natural vents in the ground, allowing Link to scale heights with ease. The Updrafts in the [[Flight Range]] are used for training by [[Rito]] warriors.{{Cite|We Rito warriors use the {{Color BotW|Red|updraft}} in this ravine to hone our aerial {{Color BotW|Red|archery}} skills.|Teba|BotW}} Except for during the "[[EX Champion Revali's Song]]" [[Main Quest]], the Flight Range's Updrafts will always regenerate Link's Stamina. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==={{EoW|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= EoW |type= Objects |category= Objects in Echoes of Wisdom |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Where it can be found * Whether it can be interacted with and if it is important to the story or a Quest * Whether it can be copied as an Echo }} {{Stub|EoW}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:MM Whirlwind.png|{{Game Label|{{MM|-}}}}An Updraft File:TWW Updraft Wind Temple.png|{{Game Label|{{TWW|-}}}}An Updraft File:TWW Official Rito Tribe Bird-Man Contest.png|{{Game Label|{{TWW|-}}}}Updrafts in the Official Rito Tribe Bird-Man Contest File:TMC Cave of Flames 2.png|{{Game Label|{{TMC|-}}}}Link riding an Updraft File:TFH Dragon Citadel Stage 3 2.png|{{Game Label|{{TFH|-}}}}The Links using Updrafts to traverse the Dragon Citadel ==See Also== {{See Also| * Crimson Cyclone * Cyclone * Revali's Gale * Tornado }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |objects= MM, MM3D, TWW, TWWHD, TMC, PH, SS, SSHD, BotW, TotK, EoW, AoC }}
